mapper.select: WITH selected_lots AS ( SELECT id FROM parking_lot WHERE id = #{lotId} ), spaces AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_spaces, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'FREE') AS free_spaces, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'OCCUPIED') AS occupied_spaces, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.status = 'DISABLED') AS disabled_spaces FROM parking_space s JOIN parking_area a ON a.id = s.area_id JOIN selected_lots l ON l.id = a.parking_lot_id ), entries AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS entry_count FROM parking_record r JOIN selected_lots l ON l.id = r.parking_lot_id WHERE r.entry_time >= #{dayStart} AND r.entry_time < #{dayEnd} ), exits AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS exit_count FROM parking_record r JOIN selected_lots l ON l.id = r.parking_lot_id WHERE r.exit_time >= #{dayStart} AND r.exit_time < #{dayEnd} ), revenue AS ( SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount_paid), 0.00) AS total_revenue FROM payment_record p JOIN parking_record r ON r.id = p.parking_record_id JOIN selected_lots l ON l.id = r.parking_lot_id WHERE p.payment_time >= #{dayStart} AND p.payment_time < #{dayEnd} AND r.status != 'ABNORMAL' ) SELECT s.total_spaces, s.free_spaces, s.occupied_spaces, s.disabled_spaces, i.entry_count, x.exit_count, p.total_revenue FROM spaces s CROSS JOIN entries i CROSS JOIN exits x CROSS JOIN revenue p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_lots)
